title: How-To Geek (2010): Wikipedia article to PDF

steps.quote: To do this, click the **Print/export** link on the left sidebar in Wikipedia when you're on an article you want to save.
steps.text: To do this, click the Print/export link on the left sidebar in Wikipedia when you're on an article you want to save.
steps.goal: The article's print and export options are shown

steps.quote: Click **Download as PDF** to have Wikipedia automatically generate a PDF copy of this article.
steps.text: Click Download as PDF to have Wikipedia automatically generate a PDF copy of this article.
steps.goal: A page offering to download the article as a PDF is shown
